recommendation: Keep the source fix. issue_request: FHIR-29031 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification OO resolution. It requested adding Medication and Substance to Observation.subject, and the final motion expanded the target set to Medication, Substance, NutritionProduct, and BiologicallyDerivedProduct with Medication/Substance understood as instance-level resources.
initial_application: The targetProfiles had already been applied through related subject-expansion commits: 11b15d7ecc added Medication and Substance under FHIR-29930, c72dfcf4e1 added BiologicallyDerivedProduct, and the Jira-recorded FHIR-29031 commit 6f1e492ad5 added NutritionProduct. The remaining gap was stale Observation.subject definition prose that still enumerated only the older subject kinds.
additional_context: OO 2020-10-15 minutes confirm FHIR-29031's Observation.subject scope and the instance clarification for Medication and Substance. FHIR-29266 and FHIR-29930 are closely related DiagnosticReport/subject-alignment issues; FHIR-29930 is already represented on the combined branch, and DiagnosticReport follow-up should remain in that separate issue family. No Zulip search found conflicting community rationale.
reconciliation: Changed source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml so Observation.subject's definition lists Medication, Substance, BiologicallyDerivedProduct, and NutritionProduct along with the other allowed subject targets. Changed source/observation/observation-event-mapping-exceptions.xml to keep the repeated Observation.subject mapping definition aligned.
